title: DeepSeek updates V4 Flash for stronger agent and Codex workflows
friendlyTitle: DeepSeek makes its V4 Flash model better at agent tasks
summary: DeepSeek has moved its updated V4 Flash model into public API beta, reporting substantial gains on coding, terminal and tool-use benchmarks. The model now supports the Responses API natively and is adapted for Codex integrations, while its architecture and size remain unchanged from the preview.
friendlySummary: DeepSeek has updated V4 Flash for coding, terminal work and tool use. Existing API users can access the new version with the same model name.
whyItMatters: Developers can test a stronger agent model without changing the existing model name or integration pattern. The benchmark claims are vendor-reported, so teams should compare reliability, latency and total task cost on their own workloads before switching.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may give developers a cheaper or stronger model for AI agents without much setup work. Test it on your own tasks before depending on the company’s benchmark numbers.
